codegen.public_route: frameWorkApplyFilmGrainDirectU8 calls ApplyLumaRowU8/ApplyChromaRowU8; no LoadSamplePlane/StoreSamplePlane or allocation calls. Legacy bind/apply remain in guarded fallback.
codegen.segment: 8 samples; two exact int32 products, signed rounding/add/clamp and byte narrowing; no calls/vector spills in hot loop. Safe 8-byte load uses scalar->vector transfer and pack uses vector->scalar transfer. Dynamic shift-vector construction remains repeated, as in original uint16 segment.
codegen.callers: Luma LUT gather inlined. Chroma gather/scaling index and seam helpers remain direct calls, as in the staged baseline. Stack scale/blend buffers do not escape.

upstream.boundary: prep copies inactive planes; apply reads original ungrained source and writes separate display; chroma reads original luma

preserved_contracts: full display padding matches legacy copy+store
existing scratch sizing/binding/validation and error ordering
HBD/portable and alias/noncanonical/odd subsampled width fallback
limits: one small three-frame affected feature fixture; no universal resolution or platform performance claim
10bit control variation is not attributed to a high-bit-depth kernel change
scratch capacities remain allocated for compatibility
not a claim about current18clip measured gap
prior_experiments: Wiener V1/V2 closed unmerged, exact patches and all rows preserved separately at /private/tmp/decoder-wiener-gap-20261018; no pooling.
